diagnostic: block 49 precision floor on the gate probe input
method: The original block 49 (base weights plus PEFT Turbo LoRA, built as the oracle builds it) upcast to float32 and run on CPU on the same probe_hidden, step-0 temb, AdaLN indices and rotary tables as the gate. The native output and the gate CPU bf16 reference are both compared against this float32 output. Run without the GPU lock, 8 threads.
interpretation: The native graph is closer to the float32 module (2.43% relative L2) than the original bf16 CPU module is (2.63%). The 2.64% native-vs-CPU-bf16 gap matches the bf16 arithmetic noise of this block on a synthetic unit-variance input; it is not evidence of a native defect. The gate verdict is unchanged: block 49 fails the predefined 0.02 limit as specified, and the criterion or probe input needs a decision before a rerun.
